description: 擅长避战的奴隶探索者。先手偷袭，输了就用钱买命。生命 {max_hp}、体力 {vitality_max} 都是最低的。

descriptions.en: A slave explorer who avoids fights. He strikes first from hiding and buys his life back when he loses. Lowest Health {max_hp} and Vitality {vitality_max}.

skills.description: 开战时敌人先失去三成生命。能用 {uses} 次，每到休息点补 {rest_recharge} 次。

descriptions.en: The enemy starts three tenths down on Health. {uses} uses, +{rest_recharge} per rest spot.

skills.description: 打输了或逃跑失败，可以用金币和道具抵掉体力损失。核心点不能。

descriptions.en: Lost a fight or failed to flee? Pay coins and items instead of Vitality (not at the core).
